identificationModule.briefTitle: Study With Palonosetron Alone in Preventing Chemotherapy-induced Nausea and Vomiting in Untreated Patients With Aggressive Non Hodgkin's Lymphomas Who Underwent Moderately Emetogenic Chemotherapy
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase II Study With Palonosetron Alone in Preventing Chemotherapy-induced Nausea and Vomiting in Untreated Patients With Aggressive Non Hodgkin's Lymphomas Who Underwent Moderately Emetogenic Chemotherapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open-label, multicenter phase II study in patients with aggressive Non Hodgkin Lymphoma scheduled to receive moderately emetogenic polychemotherapy (according to modified Hesketh classification for antiemetic therapy).

keywords: aggressive Non Hodgkin's Lymphomas treated with moderately emetogenic chemotherapy

interventions.name: Palonosetron
interventions.description: Palonosetron will be given as an intravenous bolus at the dose of 250 micrograms over 30 seconds beginning 30 minutes before chemotherapy.

primaryOutcomes.measure: overall rate of patients achieving a complete response (defined as no emetic episode and no use of rescue medication)
